text.p: Pen pictures of the Juventus players most likely to appear in Sunday's serie A clash with AC Milan.

ANGELO PERUZZI, goalkeeper, 27. Italy's first choice goalkeeper. Was suspended for a year in 1990 after he and then Roma team mate Andrea Carnevale tested positive for amphetamines. Played 16 serie A matches for Roma.

CIRO FERRARA, defender, 30. Italian international who served with Diego Maradona in great Napoli team before joining Juve in 1994. One of the pillars of the Juventus defence and has the experience and maturity to guide the others.

ALESSIO TACCHINARDI, defender, 21. Product of Juventus youth team. Started as midfielder but switched to sweeper by coach Marcello Lippi where he was hailed as "heir to Franco Baresi". Looks doubtful starter because of back problem.
SERGIO PORRINI, defender, 28. Signed from Genoa in 1993 but only made his mark last season. Equally at home as raiding full-back or central defender.
MARK IULIANO, defender, 23. Signed in close season from second division Salernitana.

ANGELO DI LIVIO, midfielder, 30. Current Italian international who was born in Rome and started at Roma. He moved on after one season without a full serie A match. Then spent nine years in second and third divisions before joining Juventus in 1994 and helping them win league title in 1995.
ATTILIO LOMBARDO, midfielder, 31. Balding veteran of Sampdoria's 1991 league title-winning team. Still very fast and likely to cover for absent Frenchman Didier Deschamps.
ZINEDINE ZIDANE, midfielder, 24. Arrived this season from Bordeaux with tag of "new Michel Platini". Has shown good understanding with Alen Boksic and Alessandro Del Piero.
VLADIMIR JUGOVIC, midfielder, 27. Former Red Star Belgrade and Sampdoria player. Skilful ball-winner who likes to get forward. Also won European Cup with Red Star in 1991.

ALESSANDRO DEL PIERO, striker, 22. Natural replacement for Roberto Baggio, on contract until year 2000. Deadly from free-kicks on edge of area. Could be making his return after being sidelined for months by injury.

MICHELE PADOVANO, striker, 30. Formerly with Genoa and Napoli, probably most under-rated striker in serie A, certainly one of the fastest. Deadly on counter-attack. Scored winner against Real Madrid in 1995 European Cup quarter-final.

ALEN BOKSIC, striker, 27. Immensely powerful son of a Croatian truck driver from Split, started out at Hajduk before moving to France. Has shown old Lazio habit of making more goals than he scores. Recovering from lengthy injury layoff.

CHRISTIAN VIERI, striker, 23. Newly-capped Italian international who scored Italy's 1,000th international goal on his debut at the weekend in World Cup qualifier against Moldova. Played in Australia before moving on to Venice and Atalanta. Bought in close season to replace Gianluca Vialli.
DIDIER DESCHAMPS, midfielder, 28. Suspended. Key link with French international team mate Zinedine Zidane. Third season at Juventus. Won European Cup with Marseille as well.
PAOLO MONTERO, defender 25. Highly valuable defender, on international duty with Uruguay. Will be missed.
